metadata.description: AWRSHIFT — adaptive decision-making framework for AI agents. Think before you build.

plugins.name: awrshift
plugins.description: Dynamic decision-making framework that adapts to task complexity. Automatically selects Quick, Standard, or Scientific mode. Use when you face a non-trivial decision, need to research before building, plan a feature or experiment, or the user says 'awrshift', 'think this through', 'research first', 'experiment', 'compare options'.
